historical_commentary.text: 4D View as a distinct product has since been discontinued, and its PV-prefixed command set is not part of current 4D's standard toolkit, making the specific commands documented here obsolete for new development. The freeze-pane/splitter UI concept itself remains a common and still-useful pattern, now more often implemented via list box form objects or web-based grid components in modern 4D applications.
related_updates: 4D View and its PV-prefixed command set have been discontinued/are not part of current 4D
